cards.name: hero
cards.title: Schedule LinkedIn posts **free, natively**
cards.sub: The clock icon handles one profile or page. A team posting from several profiles needs one shared plan.

cards.name: limits
cards.title: Great for one account, **awkward for a team**

steps.title: Clock icon
steps.text: Next to Post. Don’t click Post.

steps.title: No review
steps.text: Posts are seen once they’re live.

steps.title: Edits
steps.text: A date change means chasing people.

cards.name: bottom-line
cards.quote: One account? Use the clock icon. **A team? Share the plan, not the password.**
cards.by: Company pages stay with LinkedIn’s scheduler.
